parsed.root_cause: The incident is caused by a Chaos Mesh network partition experiment targeting the otel-demo namespace which has resulted in service latency spikes, request errors, and pod crash loops.
evidence: K8s event indicates 'Forbid spawning new job because: otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-dhs27 is still running' from chaos-mesh controller.
Multiple alerts show high latency (up to 12624s) and error rates for services in the otel-demo namespace (frontend-proxy, checkout, frontend).
A pod in the otel-demo namespace is detected in CrashLoopBackOff state.
